dialogues.speaker: Quiltec
dialogues.text: Between the rocks and the boulders... Leaping back and forth, moving ever faster...

dialogues.speaker: Quiltec
dialogues.text: So, the challenge... You up for it?

choices.text: Give me a moment to prep...

dialogues.speaker: Centaca
dialogues.text: Hehe. I felt your presence from afar, outlander warrior. Very impressive!

dialogues.speaker: Centaca
dialogues.text: Wanna take part in this Warrior's Challenge? Not to brag or anything, but I'm sure my trial will be of great help to you.

choices.text: Give me a moment to prep...

dialogues.speaker: Xiuhyo
dialogues.text: Hmm... Outlander warrior, I have a favor to ask.

dialogues.speaker: Xiuhyo
dialogues.text: I am the "Master Trainer" of our tribe, but my abilities have yet to match my title, so I can't be sure about the difficulty of the "Warrior's Challenge" I've come up with...

dialogues.speaker: Xiuhyo
dialogues.text: So, could you help me test it?

choices.text: Give me a moment to prep...

dialogues.speaker: Lirio
dialogues.text: For us, the Scions of the Canopy, agility and finesse are essential qualities, and that's why I've prepared this Warrior's Challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Lirio
dialogues.text: So, outlander warrior! Wanna take a swing at this?

choices.text: Give me a moment to prep...

dialogues.speaker: Cima
dialogues.text: Hmm, a rare guest from afar, I see. Well, what do you say? Wanna try my Warrior's Challenge?

dialogues.speaker: Cima
dialogues.text: Many a Warrior's Challenge awaits our tribal fighters throughout Natlan. And as for me, I'm one of those who arranges those challenges.

dialogues.speaker: Cima
dialogues.text: Well, don't you look like a tough one, outlander? Wanna take on the challenge that I've prepared?

choices.text: Give me a moment to prep...

dialogues.speaker: Manzana
dialogues.text: This Warrior's Challenge is designed for couriers, so it will be tough. Not that I'm underestimating you, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Manzana
dialogues.text: How about it? Want to give it a go?

choices.text: Give me a moment to prep...

dialogues.speaker: Tepache
dialogues.text: There's nothing more fun than leaping up high, before feeling the weightlessness of your fall.

dialogues.speaker: Tepache
dialogues.text: Hey there! What would you say to trying out my Warrior's Challenge?

choices.text: Give me a moment to prep...

dialogues.speaker: Matzatli
dialogues.text: Wanna try out this Spiritway challenge?

dialogues.speaker: Matzatli
dialogues.text: Well, you're here, so you might as well give it a whirl! Sure beats going back empty-handed, am I right?

choices.text: Give me a moment to prep...

dialogues.speaker: Avuia
dialogues.text: I love the feeling of sliding along the Spiritways. There's nothing more soothing than hearing the wind whistling in your ears.

dialogues.speaker: Avuia
dialogues.text: I became a Master Trainer to help our tribespeople understand the joys of gliding along Spiritways even as I train them to become warriors.

dialogues.speaker: Avuia
dialogues.text: What about you? Wanna try joining in?

choices.text: Give me a moment to prep...

dialogues.speaker: Quiltec
dialogues.text: To follow the veins of the earth is most important indeed...

dialogues.speaker: Centaca
dialogues.text: Collect as many Challenge Coins as you can and complete the challenge. I've naught but faith in you!

dialogues.speaker: Xiuhyo
dialogues.text: Um... Collect the Challenge Coins along your path and... better yet, try to catch up to the little Tepetlisaurus.

dialogues.speaker: Xiuhyo
dialogues.text: Why? Well, little Tepetlisaurs are really cute, so I thought this would make things more interesting...

dialogues.speaker: Lirio
dialogues.text: Stay quick on your feet and grab all the Challenge Coins you can... Yeah, that's kinda how the trial's gonna go.

dialogues.speaker: Cima
dialogues.text: Well, simply put, just collect Challenge Coins, as many as you can get. The more, the better! The quicker, the stronger!

dialogues.speaker: Manzana
dialogues.text: Use the grappling hook... or other means, to collect the explosive barrels and defeat your foes. This, too, is one of a messenger's many tasks... sorta.

dialogues.speaker: Tepache
dialogues.text: You can use Jet-Set Eddies to reach high places, and it's quite the experience to boot. Be careful when you land in the water, though.

dialogues.speaker: Matzatli
dialogues.text: Get on the Spiritway, then... Uh, how do I put it? Earn a higher score with some flashy-splashy motions? Something like that! There you go, super easy.

dialogues.speaker: Avuia
dialogues.text: Riding Spiritways is unbelievably fun, and I'd love to share that with more folks.
